apps.name: Broke
apps.versionDescription:
Three money bugs are fixed. A wallet you kept out of net worth was being subtracted from your cash on hand instead of just hidden, so safe-to-spend could read far below what you actually held. Budgets and the Broke Score counted money dated in the future — a bill you scheduled for next month blew this month's budget the moment you entered it. And repeating bills lost their time of day after the first month, with a 29 February bill moving itself to March.

Calmer colours too. The neon has been pulled back to something that suits an app about money — same palette, less shouting. Cards and sheets have tighter corners so a list of transactions reads as a ledger instead of a stack of pills. 3ammo is unchanged and still has opinions.
apps.localizedDescription: Broke keeps every wallet, transaction, goal, debt and bill in a database on this phone. No account, no login, no server - it works in airplane mode. 3ammo still has opinions about your spending.

versions.localizedDescription:
Three money bugs are fixed. A wallet you kept out of net worth was being subtracted from your cash on hand instead of just hidden, so safe-to-spend could read far below what you actually held. Budgets and the Broke Score counted money dated in the future — a bill you scheduled for next month blew this month's budget the moment you entered it. And repeating bills lost their time of day after the first month, with a 29 February bill moving itself to March.

Calmer colours too. The neon has been pulled back to something that suits an app about money — same palette, less shouting. Cards and sheets have tighter corners so a list of transactions reads as a ledger instead of a stack of pills. 3ammo is unchanged and still has opinions.

Plan is now a month calendar. Swipe between tabs, and swipe any record to edit or delete it. Goals reorder by dragging and can log money you already paid. Bills and salary get mark-paid and skip. Wallet splits what you owe from what you are owed. Plus fixes for every bug you reported.
3ammo is now the app icon. First launch asks what to call you.
Offline-first: the phone is now the source of truth. Local database, no backend, no login. Mutual-debt offsetting, repeating bills, and a from-zero reset.
